name: Smile Smile Smile
source:
Several years of suffering are about to end right now. Burrowing deeper into the snow, Dima could feel his limbs gradually going numb and every breath becoming more painful. If only he had known it was this simple, albeit painful, he would have done it sooner...

"Are you alright?"

What an annoying question... Had his brain decided to play a trick on him?

"Do you need help?"

No. It seems this is not a hallucination this time. He would have gladly cursed the person standing in front of him, but the warmth radiating from their hand could be felt even from a distance, forcing him to accept the outstretched palm.

[Translated from [url=https://t.me/ThreeeSmiiile/8]Telegram[/url]]
translation:
几年的苦难现在即将结束。深入雪地，迪玛感觉自己的四肢渐渐麻木，每一次呼吸都变得更加痛苦。如果他早知道这么简单，虽然很痛苦，他也会早点这么做的……

“你还好吗？”

真是个烦人的问题……难道他的大脑决定跟他开个玩笑？

“你需要帮助吗？”

不，看来这次不是幻觉了。他很想咒骂面前的人，但隔着老远都能感觉到对方手上散发出的温暖，让他不得不接受伸出的手掌。

[译自[url=https://t.me/ThreeeSmiiile/8]Telegram[/url]]
